title: Körperverletzung nach Streit in Gaststätte – Wirt verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: After a dispute over alcohol service at a bar in Oberschöneweide, a 63-year-old guest allegedly punched the 54-year-old landlord in the face, and the landlord later suffered a serious head injury. The landlord was taken to hospital; his life is not in danger.
